notes: stage 3 steps of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, horn free, 5 V from the DPS-150 over the feed diode, experiment image, sitting 1: steps/capture-1 (27 chains of a base duty, a step up and the step back, bases 20, 30 and 40 %, steps 2, 5 and 10 %, from the guards and the guards moved in by a sixth and a third of the travel, directions +1 and -1: 54 chain-directions, 108 edges, 162 levels, 54 starts from rest) and steps/reversal-1 (d then -d at 10, 20 and 30 %, both orders, 6 reversals). Current through stage 1 current-scale over each sweep's torque-off zero with the in-drive offset out, the crest sample; volts through terminal-chain; construction A = D x V_on, B = share x V_on - (1 - share) R_brk i with sample-timing's edge lags (mean of the graded rails) and bridge-states' low-side loop. Speed by the tracked ripple tach on the drive current (6 events per rev), never the pot. Ke the ladder result's, R the resistance result's locked laps, J mg90-b's speed-torque value in the current route only. Bounds are mean +/- sd over the repeats unless the unit says otherwise: the ensemble groups' bootstrap sd over the edges (200 resamples, seeded), a line's se, or a reversal pair's two values. Velocity loop. tau_m_ms the one-constant whole-chain model's time constant, tau_m_se_ms its standard error; tau_m_by_base, _by_direction and _by_start report only; tau_m_step_up_ms, tau_m_step_down_ms and tau_m_runup_from_rest_ms the three-constant model at bases 20 and 30 % with every constant under 100 ms (run-up under 150 ms), report only; tau_m_from_current_ms the up 10 % ensemble's slow fall, an open discrepancy against tau_m_ms. speed_delay_ms bound-only, value the median fitted delay (at its bound 0), hi the 90th percentile, under the tach's cycle; speed_delay_max_ms report only. k_w_rev_s_per_pct the gain per % of duty on 5 V; k_w_up, k_w_down and k_w_by_* report only; k_w_per_v_a_rev_s_per_v and k_w_per_v_a_after_rev_s_per_v construction-dependent (A, the crest volts before and after the edge); k_w_per_v_b_over_a construction B's gain per volt over A's, steps up. k_w_vs_*_slope a line's slope with se bounds, none a finding, start and minutes collinear by the capture's order. step_down_over_up report only, 1.3 sigma from 1. speed_duty_line_* a line through the settled levels, se bounds. k_i_settled_ma_per_pct and di_settled_per_pct_ma the same quantity, the settled current's change per %. travel_per_step_counts report only, signed. Current loop. current_delay_up_us and _down_us the ensemble's start t0 from the flip row; current_delay_bound_us bound-only, one 50 us row either side of the flip row. tau_e_up_us and tau_e_down_us at 10 % are the numbers of record, their difference 2.8 sigma (likely, cause open); tau_e_*_5pct_us and tau_e_by_group_us report only. tau_e_inductance_notebook_us and l_inductance_notebook_mh comparisons. di_e_per_v_up_ma_per_v and _down the plateau per volt of applied change under A at the edge, construction-dependent; di_e_per_v_up_at_2ms the fast fit's plateau, report only. r_step_* is the resistance a small step reads on the crest current, an open discrepancy against the locked laps and NOT a value of R; the per-edge r_step_a_ohm, _up, _down, _after and r_takeback_ensemble_ohm count each edge twice (its 18-edge and its 6-edge group's shape); r_step_a_* and r_step_b_* construction-dependent; r_takeback_ohm and r_takeback_ensemble_ohm volts-free, resting on Ke. r_locked_ohm quoted. l_step_up_mh tau_e up x the locked R, bounds from tau_e's bootstrap sd; l_step_up_r_step_mh and l_step_down_mh report only. jump_term_up_ma report only, not a finding. current_ensemble_rms_ma value up 10 %, lo down 10 %, hi up 5 %, three residuals, not bounds. Levels. level_{20,30,40}_speed_rev_s and _current_ma the settled levels (speed change under 2.5 % across the last 40 ms, at least 20 tach cycles) pooled over both directions, mean +/- sd; level_*_x_a_mv and _x_b_mv the EMF balance V - R_locked i - Ke w under A and B, construction-dependent. pot_over_tach and counts_per_motor_turn_measured report only, pot-table grades the slope. Starts and reversals. takeup_still_ms_dir_* and play_from_rest_*_dir_* per direction (pos +1, neg -1), the play by the current route with the type J; pot_shift_at_start_counts_dir_* in the drive's frame, so negative for -1 means the raw pos reads up. backlash_bound_*: value the +1 starts' mean play, lo 0 (the -1 starts cross none), hi the +1 mean plus its sd; moderate on the value, high on the bound under 0.35 turns; the tag pass pins it. reversal_{10,20,30}_*: value the mean of the two orders, bounds their two values; t_zero_emf_a unusable at 10 %; play_turns resolves nothing beyond +/-0.3 turns, report only; tau_after_ms report only. pot_jump_per_amp_counts the pot's current-coupled offset on the -1 leg, likely, bounds the six reversals' range. reversal_limit_engaged 0 when no duty was cut. chains the count.

tau_m_ms.unit: ms, mechanical time constant of the speed's response, one whole-chain first-order model per chain and direction, mean +/- sd over 54

tau_m_step_up_ms.unit: ms, the step up's own time constant in the three-constant chain model, bases 20 and 30 %

tau_m_step_down_ms.unit: ms, the step back's own, the same model

tau_m_runup_from_rest_ms.unit: ms, the base segment's approach from rest (after the take-up), slower than the small steps

tau_m_from_current_ms.unit: ms, the time constant of the current's fall after the 10 % step up, ensemble of 18 edges, bootstrap sd

speed_delay_ms.unit: ms, the speed's delay after the duty register's flip: the median over 54 chains with the 90th percentile as the upper bound; under the tach's cycle resolution, a bound not a value

k_w_rev_s_per_pct.unit: rev/s per % of duty on 5 V, settled speed change of the chain model, 5 and 10 % steps up and down, mean +/- sd over 72 edges

k_w_per_v_a_rev_s_per_v.unit: rev/s per V of applied volts under construction A (the duty step times the crest tap volts before the edge)

k_w_per_v_a_after_rev_s_per_v.unit: rev/s per V, A with the tap volts after the edge (the rail's move on the step in)

k_w_per_v_b_over_a.unit: ratio, construction B's gain per volt over A's: the brake term's change on a step

k_w_vs_base_slope.unit: rev/s per % per % of base, a line through the 72 edges

k_w_vs_start_slope.unit: rev/s per % per unit of start share

k_w_vs_minutes_slope.unit: rev/s per % per minute through the capture

step_down_over_up.unit: ratio of the speed change back to the change up, paired by chain, mean +/- sd over 54

speed_duty_line_slope_rev_s_per_pct.unit: rev/s per %, a line through the settled levels 20 to 50 %

speed_duty_line_intercept_rev_s.unit: rev/s at zero duty by that line (negative: the floor)

k_i_settled_ma_per_pct.unit: mA per % of duty, the settled current's change, chain model levels

up 2.unit: raw pot counts the stepped segment traveled, signed by the direction, so the mean sits near zero and the sd carries the size; window as cut by the runway

up 5.unit: raw pot counts the stepped segment traveled, signed by the direction, so the mean sits near zero and the sd carries the size; window as cut by the runway

up 10.unit: raw pot counts the stepped segment traveled, signed by the direction, so the mean sits near zero and the sd carries the size; window as cut by the runway

down 2.unit: raw pot counts the stepped segment traveled, signed by the direction, so the mean sits near zero and the sd carries the size; window as cut by the runway

down 5.unit: raw pot counts the stepped segment traveled, signed by the direction, so the mean sits near zero and the sd carries the size; window as cut by the runway

down 10.unit: raw pot counts the stepped segment traveled, signed by the direction, so the mean sits near zero and the sd carries the size; window as cut by the runway

current_delay_up_us.unit: us after the duty register's flip row, the exponential's start, 10 % steps up, ensemble of 18, bootstrap sd

current_delay_bound_us.unit: us, the delay from the command's edge as the stream shows it: within one row of the flip either way

tau_e_up_us.unit: us, electrical time constant of the crest current's rise, 10 % steps up, bootstrap sd

tau_e_inductance_notebook_us.unit: us, the inductance notebook's locked bursts, comparison

di_e_per_v_up_ma_per_v.unit: mA per V of applied change (A), the plateau the slow fit extrapolates to the edge, steps up, bootstrap sd

di_e_per_v_up_at_2ms_ma_per_v.unit: mA per V, the electrical fit's plateau (1 to 2 ms)

r_step_a_ohm.unit: ohm, dV_A / di_e per edge, 10 % steps up and down, the group's shape scaled to each edge, mean +/- sd over 72 rows: the 36 edges, each with its 18-edge group's shape and its 6-edge base group's

r_step_a_after_ohm.unit: ohm, with the tap volts after the edge

r_step_b_ensemble_up_ohm.unit: ohm, the same under B (the brake term's change at the plateau)

r_takeback_ohm.unit: ohm, Ke x dw / (plateau - settled change) from the chain model's jumps and levels, no volts in it, 5 and 10 % steps

r_takeback_ensemble_ohm.unit: ohm, the same with the ensemble plateau per edge

r_locked_ohm.unit: ohm, the resistance notebook's locked laps, comparison

l_step_up_mh.unit: mH, tau_e (up) x the locked R

l_step_up_r_step_mh.unit: mH, tau_e (up) x the step's own R under A

l_step_down_mh.unit: mH, tau_e (down) x the locked R

jump_term_up_ma.unit: mA, an instant jump added to the up 10 % ensemble model; its residual gain is under 1 %, not a finding

current_ensemble_rms_ma.unit: mA, the residual of the ensemble fits (up 10, down 10, up 5)

level_20_speed_rev_s.unit: rev/s, tach, settled levels at this duty

level_20_x_a_mv.unit: mV, V_A - R_locked i - Ke_ladder w

level_30_speed_rev_s.unit: rev/s, tach, settled levels at this duty

level_30_x_a_mv.unit: mV, V_A - R_locked i - Ke_ladder w

level_40_speed_rev_s.unit: rev/s, tach, settled levels at this duty

level_40_x_a_mv.unit: mV, V_A - R_locked i - Ke_ladder w

pot_over_tach.unit: ratio of the pot's speed (nominal counts per turn) to the tach's over the settled windows

counts_per_motor_turn_measured.unit: pot counts per motor turn by that ratio

takeup_still_ms_dir_pos.unit: ms the pot stays within 2.5 counts after the drive starts from rest

play_from_rest_turns_dir_pos.unit: motor turns the rotor makes before the output moves, current route (type J, this Ke), less the output's own 2.5 counts

play_from_rest_turns_drag_dir_pos.unit: motor turns, the same with 30 mA of rotor drag taken off

pot_shift_at_start_counts_dir_pos.unit: raw pot counts the reading moves the moment the drive starts, before motion

takeup_still_ms_dir_neg.unit: ms the pot stays within 2.5 counts after the drive starts from rest

play_from_rest_turns_dir_neg.unit: motor turns the rotor makes before the output moves, current route (type J, this Ke), less the output's own 2.5 counts

play_from_rest_turns_drag_dir_neg.unit: motor turns, the same with 30 mA of rotor drag taken off

pot_shift_at_start_counts_dir_neg.unit: raw pot counts the reading moves the moment the drive starts, before motion

backlash_bound_turns.unit: motor turns: the leading value from the +1 starts, the bracket from the -1 starts (none) to the +1 starts' upper sd

reversal_10_t_zero_ms.unit: ms from the flip to the motor's zero crossing, current route, two orders

reversal_10_t_zero_emf_a_ms.unit: ms, the EMF route under A

reversal_10_pot_restart_ms.unit: ms from the flip to the pot leaving its extremum by 2.5 counts

reversal_10_play_turns.unit: motor turns, the gap at the restart by the current route, pot jump removed, two orders (one each)

reversal_10_tau_after_ms.unit: ms, the approach to the new speed after the restart

reversal_10_pot_jump_counts.unit: raw pot counts the reading jumps at the flip

reversal_20_t_zero_ms.unit: ms from the flip to the motor's zero crossing, current route, two orders

reversal_20_t_zero_emf_a_ms.unit: ms, the EMF route under A

reversal_20_pot_restart_ms.unit: ms from the flip to the pot leaving its extremum by 2.5 counts

reversal_20_play_turns.unit: motor turns, the gap at the restart by the current route, pot jump removed, two orders (one each)

reversal_20_tau_after_ms.unit: ms, the approach to the new speed after the restart

reversal_20_pot_jump_counts.unit: raw pot counts the reading jumps at the flip

reversal_30_t_zero_ms.unit: ms from the flip to the motor's zero crossing, current route, two orders

reversal_30_t_zero_emf_a_ms.unit: ms, the EMF route under A

reversal_30_pot_restart_ms.unit: ms from the flip to the pot leaving its extremum by 2.5 counts

reversal_30_play_turns.unit: motor turns, the gap at the restart by the current route, pot jump removed, two orders (one each)

reversal_30_tau_after_ms.unit: ms, the approach to the new speed after the restart

reversal_30_pot_jump_counts.unit: raw pot counts the reading jumps at the flip

pot_jump_per_amp_counts.unit: raw pot counts per A of plugging current at the flip, both orders

reversal_limit_engaged.unit: 1 if the current limit cut any duty at a reversal (0: none did)
